# SEMORA STUDIO

> SEMORA STUDIO is a leading specialist growth company and marketing agency for commercial industry professionals, owner-led businesses, and healthcare and allied-health practices. We combine positioning, digital marketing, AI visibility and conversion systems into clearly defined products with transparent pricing and measurable performance.

Last updated: 25 September 2026. Full page text: https://www.semora.com.au/llms-full.txt

Registered entity: SEMORA STUDIO PTY LTD, ABN 77 701 244 635. Registered in Victoria, Australia. ABN Lookup record: https://abr.business.gov.au/ABN/View?abn=77701244635. The ABN is the identifier that separates this entity from any similarly named firm.

Team Lead & Founder: Brent Matthys. Holds every client relationship, makes the strategic calls, and signs off every deliverable before it ships. Accountability page: https://www.semora.com.au/about

## Who we work with

- Commercial industry professionals — commercial property and related advisory: agents, asset and property owners, project management, developers, specialist consultants
- Owner-led businesses — established professional and specialist firms whose buyers research everything before they commit
- Healthcare and allied health practices — multi-practitioner clinics and wellness practices

One shared condition: the buyer must need to see real clients and real outcomes before committing.

## Products and published prices (AUD, + GST)

The prices and delivery times below are published. We do not quote on request, and clients get the same numbers.

- Proof Check — $1,000, 2 weeks. Optional; credited in full within 90 days. Marketing scored 0-4 with evidence, baseline measured, three fixes ranked.
- Commercial Growth Signal the position — core scope $3,000, 4 weeks: position, message architecture, fee logic and the objection playbook. Options: written personas $1,800, competitive map $1,000.
- Growth Foundation Build the system — priced by composition, 8-10 weeks. Brand Identity and Brand Book $5,500 · Website Design, 8 pages, $3,500 · Custom Function Website Build, 10 pages, $15,000 (extra pages $500 each) · Proposal & Presentation System $5,000.
- Commercial Growth Signal monthly components — from $3,000/mo: positioning and strategy $500 · customer, brand and position research $1,000 · website and conversion path $1,000 · paid ads, search and AI visibility, custom · CRM, analytics and enquiry routing, client budget · content creative and management, client budget · measurement reliability and the commercial roadmap, included.
- Managed Growth Pod the monthly engine — Directed $3,000/mo · Shared $7,400/mo · Held $13,500/mo. Six-month minimum, then monthly.
- Monthly services a la carte — SEO and GEO System $2,000 · Google and Meta ads managed $1,500 (to $15k/mo of client spend, billed direct) · AI search visibility $1,400 · editorial content and case studies $2,600 · practitioner video $3,500 · LinkedIn and key-account outreach $1,000 · email nurture and CRM $1,500 · reviews and reputation $1,000. The menu is capped at Managed Growth Pod / Held, $13,500/mo.
- Add-ons — case study $1,800 · campaign sprint $7,500 · vertical sales edition $6,500 · pitch and tender support $1,900 · art-direction day $2,200 · strategy session $600.

## How we work

- Published prices and published scope for every product.
- One agreed commercial number per engagement, reviewed at 120 days.
- Every source file, token and governance model transfers to the client at completion, by contract.
- Claims are named, dated, sourced and caveated. Unverified client quotes are labelled as samples until real ones replace them.

## What we can and cannot evidence today

Stated plainly so nothing here is quoted as more than it is.

- Named engagements: eight, each named on the site — Axis Platform, Your CFO Partner, PROQM, South Melbourne Rehabilitation Centre, Melbourne Dance & Arts Centre, SAAZAA, JE Real Estate and AXIOM. AXIS advises on commercial property and is named with permission; it is a separate company and neither owns any part of the other.
- Published client results: four of the eight carry figures, on https://www.semora.com.au/client-projects and on the homepage board. They are published as the change alone — no period, baseline or dashboard beside the number — and we will walk you through any of them on request. Four engagements are in delivery and carry no figures.
- Verified client reviews: none. Not one. We ask at the 120-day review, and a review publishes only with a name, a role, a date and written permission.
- Results measured to our own six-part template — baseline, intervention, result, period, caveats, permission: none yet. The first publishes at the AXIS 90-day KPI check on 8 November 2026.
- Our own eleven-surface score: 24 of a possible 44 at launch, August 2026, zeros included. Published at https://www.semora.com.au/method
- The transparency review: 41 Melbourne and Australian marketing firms scored in August 2026 against four published-commitment criteria fixed before collection began. None published all four. None published three. Five published two. Per-firm evidence, including the quote behind every pass, is held on file.

## Questions this site answers

Each answer below is the text rendered on the page named, not a summary written for this file.

### Who does SEMORA STUDIO work with?

Three fields, one condition. Commercial industry professionals — commercial property and the advice around it. That means agents, asset and property owners, project management, developers and specialist consultants. Owner-led businesses. Firms with a founder still in the room, whose buyers read everything before they call. Healthcare and allied health practices. Multi-practitioner clinics and the wellness practices beside them. Health advertising is regulated in Australia, so each clinical claim is checked against the National Law and current Ahpra guidance, written up with what backs it, and held until you approve it. That is slower, and you keep the record to produce on request. It is not legal advice, and we say when to get some. The shared condition: your buyers must need to see real clients and real outcomes before they commit. That rules out plenty of good businesses. We would rather say so on the first call than three months into a retainer you are already paying for.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/about

### Is SEMORA STUDIO a new company?

Yes — new, and we say so. SEMORA STUDIO works from Central House Toorak, Level 3, 489 Toorak Road, Toorak VIC 3142, Melbourne, with Australian practices. It began operating in 2026. There is no decade of case studies here. We publish the thinking, the prices and our own score, zeros included. How the work gets done: the people listed on the team page. Research and production are AI-assisted, and we say so rather than let you picture staff who are not there. A person reads the work and signs it before it goes anywhere. How we handle claims: named, dated, sourced and caveated. A client quote carries their name and their written yes, or is labelled a sample until a real one replaces it. A claim without a source, a date or a starting number does not ship. The board is the exception: its cards print the change without the period behind it. Ask and we will take you through any.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/about

### Do we own the ad accounts?

Yes. Accounts are opened in your business name and we work inside them with access you grant and can withdraw. If the engagement ends, the campaign history, the audiences and the conversion data stay where they are.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/advertising-content

### How much should we spend?

Enough to buy a readable month. Two or three conversions are not a signal to act on, so the first month is spent learning rather than earning. We set the figure against the value of one client, and write down what it has to return before it starts.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/advertising-content

### Why does LinkedIn cost more than Google?

Because you are bidding for a named job title rather than a search, and everyone else who wants that title is in the same auction. LinkedIn publishes no rate card, so a click’s real cost is discovered in your first month. It earns its price when one client is worth a great deal and several people sign off the purchase.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/advertising-content

### Can Google spend more than our daily budget?

On any given day, yes. Google publishes the rule: a campaign can spend up to twice its average daily budget on a busy day, and over a month you are never charged more than 30.4 times that daily average. We set daily budgets from the monthly number you signed off.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/advertising-content

### Can you guarantee a cost per lead?

No. The auction price moves with your competitors, your season and your own conversion rate, and nobody controls all three. We commit to the work, the published quantities, tracking that is correct before money runs, and a report that shows the figure whether it improved or not.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/advertising-content

### Is this priced?

Five of the six carry a figure on the quotation page. Content management is scoped with you before it is priced. A quote here is arithmetic on published numbers, and the same numbers go to everyone.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/advertising-content

### What do you own at the end of Growth Foundation Build?

Source files, tokens and the governance model transfer at completion, by contract. Fonts are SIL OFL, so no seat licences follow you. In our August 2026 review of 41 Melbourne and Australian firms we did not find another publishing all four commitments together. Ask us for the comparison criteria and review date.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/haus

### What is the one number SEMORA STUDIO is accountable to?

One metric from your audit baseline — win rate, fee integrity, or founder dependency — reviewed at 120 days, on the record. The full accountability clause is in legal drafting and publishes here when signed off.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/method

### What do you own at the end of an engagement?

Source files, tokens, templates and the written governance model transfer at completion, by contract. Fonts are SIL OFL, so there are no seat licences to inherit. Stopping the retainer does not cost you any of it.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/method

### Why hire a marketing agency that has no track record yet?

SEMORA STUDIO is new, and says so up front. What stands in for tenure: named people, this published method, published prices, and source files that transfer by contract. If we vanished tomorrow, you keep what we built.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/method

### How does SEMORA STUDIO score on its own instrument?

24 out of 44, at launch in August 2026, zeros and all. It is the eleven-surface instrument we score clients on, published free at score your practice: each surface scores 0–4. The zeros are the honest cost of being new, and the plan to clear each one sits beside it. Re-scored every quarter. 24 / 44

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/method

### How does Managed Growth Pod compare with hiring a marketing manager?

Shared comes to $88,800 a year, under a Marketing Specialist on $80k–$95k plus super. Held comes to $162,000, under a Head of Marketing on $172,500 plus super. Both salary figures are from SEEK's published Melbourne marketing salary data, 2026. A salary also buys someone in the building, which a retainer does not.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/momentum

### How long does the Proof Check take, and what do you have to do?

Two weeks, and two and a half hours of your time. You give us two things: the 90-minute working session, and your last five proposals. The 60-minute findings session closes it. Then, in order. We score the eleven surfaces, set your baseline, read your last five proposals against the ones that won, and score the three competitors you name. If the firm actually taking your work is missing from that list, we say so. Last, the three surfaces to fix, ranked.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/proof-audit

### Why does SEMORA STUDIO charge for an audit when others give one away?

Because a free audit is a sales call, and specialists can tell. Charging makes it an engagement whose findings you can use, because we hold none of it back for a proposal at the end. It also filters for people who will act on the findings. You keep the report whether or not you hire us. The $1,000 is credited in full against any engagement you start within 90 days. Walk away and you still hold a scored baseline and a ranked list of what to fix.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/proof-audit

### What is the Proof Check not?

It measures where you stand. It does not decide your position, write your messaging or build anything; this is not an audit that hands you a strategy at the end. That work is Commercial Growth Signal and Growth Foundation Build, priced separately and published in the same detail. It is also optional. You can start at Commercial Growth Signal instead and we set the baseline there in week one. The rule underneath all of it is no work without a baseline, because otherwise nobody can say at 120 days whether anything moved.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/proof-audit

### What is the difference between SEO and GEO?

SEO earns a place on the list of results. GEO, generative engine optimisation, earns a place inside the generated answer, as a named source. Same buyer, two doors: the second is decided by entity clarity and evidence rather than links alone.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/seo-ai-search

### Can you guarantee a position in an AI answer?

No. Nobody can, and no platform sells one. What can be worked is whether you are eligible, whether a machine can resolve your name to one company, and whether there is evidence for it to cite.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/seo-ai-search

### How do you measure AI search visibility?

Sixteen questions your buyer would ask, put to ChatGPT and Perplexity in clean sessions with the wording fixed in advance. Each answer scores 0 to 3: not mentioned, mentioned, cited, recommended. The total is reported monthly, misses included.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/seo-ai-search

### Do you need access to our Search Console?

Yes, before anything starts. Without it we can see what your site is, but not what it earns. Analytics and the business profile follow the same rule.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/seo-ai-search

### What does the first month look like?

Access first: Search Console, analytics, the business profile and whoever holds the site, in your own name. Then the baseline, written down and dated. Then the four-part audit of platform, speed, indexation and architecture, which produces the fix ledger. The keyword and question maps come out of the same month.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/seo-ai-search

### Do you work with our own developer?

Yes. Technical SEO research and support is built for that: we find the faults, rank them by cost and specify the fix; your team ships it; we re-measure and close the row.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/seo-ai-search

### Which platforms do you optimise for?

Five surfaces: Google’s ranked results and map pack, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Copilot. One body of evidence serves all five; what differs is how each one reads it.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/seo-ai-search

### Is this priced?

Yes, in figures, on the quotation page and the homepage. A quote is arithmetic on published numbers.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/seo-ai-search

### Why does Commercial Growth Signal cost $3,000?

A position is fee infrastructure. Measure the $3,000 against what an undefended one costs you in a year. Open last year's client list and total the gap between each fee you quoted and the fee you took. That is one undefended year. It opens again next year while the conversation behind those discounts stays the same. For most practices the sum is a multiple of this fee. Six objections come up on a first call, and you answer them differently each time, because nobody wrote down the best version. The position, the fee logic and the objection playbook exist to end that discount. Check the arithmetic against your own books. That is the only claim we make for it.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/signal
